newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Monroe, N.J..

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
The Board of Education of the Township of Monroe,
(in the County of Middlesex),
New Jersey
School District Bonds
SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Secretary of the Board of Education of the Township of Monroe (the Board of Education'') in the Main Conference Room in the
Administration Building of the School District, 423 Buckelew Avenue, Jamesburg, New Jersey, subject to the provisions of the official Notice of Sale dated July 10, 1997 (the Notice of Sale'').
Sale Date: Tuesday, July 22, 1997
Time: 11:00 a.m.
Bonds Dated: August 1, 1997
Maturities: August 1 in the years and principal amounts set forth below
Principal Principal Principal
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
2005 665,000 Denominations:$5,000 e ach or any integral multiple
thereof, except that
such minimum amount of the last maturing Bonds
in excess of the largest principal amount
thereof equaling a multiple of $5,000 will be
in the denomination of $1,000 or any integral
multiple thereof, as may be necessary to comply
with the proposal of the successful bidder of
the Bonds to accept less than the full amount
of the Bonds offered for public sale in
accordance with the Notice of Sale.
Interest Rate:The Bonds will bear interest at the rate or rates per annum
specified by the successful bidder determined
in accordance
with the Notice of Sale.
Legal Opinion:McCarter & English, Newark, New Jersey

Copies of the Notice of Sale and the Preliminary Official Statement relating to the Bonds may be obtained from Wayne Holliday, Business Administrator/Board Secretary of the Board of Education of the Township of Monroe, 423 Buckelew Avenue, Jamesburg, New Jersey 08831 (telephone (908) 521- 1500).
(From The Bond Buyer)
